_about: NCAA NET page name -> hoopsteams `school`, for the names modules/hoops-net.js cannot match on its own (#533). Each entry was checked against the hoopsteams row it pairs with. A name that matches nothing fails the hoops-net job loudly, listing it: add it here. notOurs: NCAA names with NO hoopsteams row (left out of the match, named in every run's summary). notRanked: hoopsteams schools NCAA does not rank (they keep their CBBD-adjusted or Torvik rank in ranksFor, and the run notes them as a warning). Both start empty; add to them only after checking.
